summary: Azul S.A. filed a 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 earnings release (period ended September 30, 2026). No transaction, offer, or corporate action is announced; the disclosure covers operating results, including R$1.2 billion EBITDA on R$5.6 billion revenue, record RASK and PRASK, a 6.9% year-over-year capacity reduction, and R$763.6 million recurring free cash flow. Liquidity stands at R$4.1 billion, rising to R$4.6 billion pro forma including a US$100 million American Airlines equity investment received in October. Financing references cover FNAC and FGE credit lines. This is a routine quarterly earnings filing, not a special situation.
